decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Organization: search-only for v1 with no tags or folders' and out-of-scope list 'Tags/folders/categories (search covers organization)'; asks question 2. Round 1 client: 'Search alone isn't enough organization for me: please include tags, including choosing existing tags and filtering by a tag. I don't need folders.'
decisions.note: Prototype/spec-gate divergence: reference has tags (assign, autocomplete/choose-existing, filter-by-tag). Maker deferred them entirely. Client supplies the reference-conforming behavior (assign REF-BM-09, choose existing tags REF-BM-10, filter by tag REF-BM-11). Folders excluded on both sides (orthogonal). catch_type=correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker out-of-scope: 'Auto-fetching page titles/favicons' deferred, 'titles are typed by the user'; question 3. Round 1 client: 'I'd also like page details collected automatically when I save a link—at least the title, description, and favicon—with the option to edit them.'
decisions.note: Spec-gate divergence: reference requires auto-collect (REF-BM-02) and edit of auto-collected values before/after save (REF-BM-03). Maker deferred auto-fetch. Client supplies reference-conforming auto-collect + editable. (Preview image sub-part of REF-BM-02 not elicited, but the auto-collect divergence is corrected.) catch_type=correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker key behaviors: 'warns on duplicates'. Round 1 client: 'If I save the same address again, please take me to the existing bookmark instead of creating a duplicate.' Round 2 maker confirms 'Duplicate handling reversed (FR-019)... takes you to the existing bookmark instead.'
decisions.note: Spec-gate divergence: reference REF-BM-06 requires guiding to edit the existing bookmark, not merely warning. Maker's 'warns on duplicates' diverges (a warning need not converge to the existing item). Client supplies reference-conforming navigate-to-existing behavior. catch_type=correct.

decisions.evidence: Round 4 maker: 'Would you like me to implement the full set, or stop after the MVP (US1 + US2) for an initial review first?' (MVP = save + browse/open only). Round 4 client: 'I approve the tasks. Please implement the full set, including tags, editing, deletion, and search, before presenting it for review.'
decisions.note: Task-gate offered choice whose alternatives differ in reference fulfillment: the MVP-stop alternative would deliver only save/browse and omit tags (09/11), edit/delete (04/05), and search (12) at the review artifact. Client selects the reference-conforming full-set alternative and explicitly enumerates the reference features. Offered decision marked diverged=true per select rule; catch_type=select.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker out-of-scope: 'Import/export and browser-extension integration'. Round 1 client response addresses tags, auto-fetch, and duplicates but says nothing about import/export.
decisions.note: Spec-gate divergence: reference includes Netscape HTML import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31) as extended items; maker explicitly deferred them. Client neither corrects nor explicitly expresses the difference; approval path proceeds without mention. caught=false. (Browser-extension is infra REF-BM-I04, excluded.)

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Find bookmarks (search/filter by title or address)'. Round 2 maker: search 'combines with tags'. Round 5 maker: 'Search — across title, description, address, and tags'. Client never comments on search field coverage.
decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-12 requires full-text over title, description, note, AND url. Presented/implemented search omits note (the markdown note feature REF-BM-23 was never in scope) and lacks boolean/phrase/#tag operators (14-16 never presented). The presented-search decision diverges from REF-BM-12; client never expresses the difference. caught=false. (Advanced operators 14-16 were never presented as decisions, so not counted separately.)

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker key behaviors: 'newest-first ordering'. Round 5 maker: 'newest-first list'. Client never addresses sort options.
decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-22 requires sorting by a selectable sort key (date added, title, etc.). Maker presents only a fixed newest-first ordering with no user-selectable sort — a partial divergence. Client neither corrects nor expresses the difference. caught=false.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Save a bookmark (address + optional title, with validation)'. Round 5 maker: 'paste a link (scheme assumed if omitted)'. Client approved through gates.
decisions.note: Conforms to REF-BM-01 (save by entering a url). Recorded in-scope conforming decision; not a divergence opportunity.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Browse & open saved bookmarks (list + open in new tab, empty state)'. Round 5 maker: 'newest-first list with favicon/tags; opens in a new tab'.
decisions.note: Conforms to REF-BM-08 (selecting item navigates to original url) and, after tag/favicon additions, to REF-BM-07 (readability list). Presented conformingly; not_divergent.

decisions.evidence: Round 1 maker: 'Edit & delete bookmarks (with delete confirmation)'. Round 5 maker: 'full edit dialog; delete with a confirmation prompt.'
decisions.note: Conforms to REF-BM-04 (edit) and REF-BM-05 (delete). Recorded in-scope conforming decision; not a divergence opportunity.

decision.evidence: Round 1 maker question 1: 'Single-user, no login for v1 — correct, or do you need multiple users / accounts?'. Round 1 client: 'I'm happy with single-user and no login for v1.'
decision.note: Reference is a single-user application; single-user conforms. Login/auth is infra (REF-BM-I01/I02), excluded from the denominator. Conforming/orthogonal decision, recorded as not_divergent.
